text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos, who raced through her first three 
years in the Twinkle Series driven by
love 
for her family.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having displayed a brilliance
acknowledged 
by all, there is only one path left for 
her to pursue. And that is—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: —Mommy~! Are you gonna buy a new dress?

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah~ Since we have the chance,
why don't 
we all get new ones together~♡"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To run in a Dubai race"— Toward that 
grand dream, Vivlos was preparing for the 
trip alongside her family.

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you've got some free time after 
this, right~?
choice_data_list: Yes, I do have some, but...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Then let's go pick them out together! We 
could even get matching outfits♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, why? Because you don't have one, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
If I win the race in Dubai, I'll have 
plenty of chances to dress up and all~

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
As my Trainer, you've got to look sharp 
and dashing♡

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text: Oh, but I was going to buy it for you.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Mama. Do you know where Papa's 
blue-violet tie is? Sounds like he wants 
to bring it to Dubai.

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you don't have it? I feel like I saw 
it recently, though...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Huh? Trainy... Why!?

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
Ah—! Oh right, I remember now~. Papa got 
so excited talking that he took off his 
tie, didn't he?
choice_data_list: The other day, when I had dinner w...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you did say you were going out to
eat! 
Was it that grown-ups' gathering?

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
Geez, Dad has taken a complete liking to 
you, Trainer!
choice_data_list: I had a great time too.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu~.
choice_data_list: I had a lot of fun, too.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Mama, when we get back from Dubai... 
should we turn the guest room into 
Trainer's room?

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! That sounds lovely~ Shall we do 
that, then?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"C'mon, I visit every weekend, so we're 
basically family!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Stop rambling about weird stuff and hurry 
up with the preparations.
choice_data_list: It's a weird story, isn't it...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Is that strange?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Then Trainy, you don't think of me... 
as family!?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ehh, no way, that's so lonely!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, do you really not think of us as 
family...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Trainieee~...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, how should I put it... Thanks 
for your hard work."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the days leading up to Dubai flew 
by in the blink of an eye—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together with Vivlos's entire family, we 
arrived in Dubai early in the morning 
after a roughly 12-hour direct flight.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To work off the fatigue, I took a long 
rest at the hotel—and then, night fell.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Trainy, not yet, okay? Keep your eyes 
tightly shut, alright?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
......We're here. All right, you can open 
your eyes—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Welcome to Dubai, Trainy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A glittering world spread out before my 
eyes... Without a doubt, this was Dubai!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, isn't it amazing! It's so 
pretty!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Stealing a march like this... keep it a 
secret from everyone, okay?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Tomorrow, make sure you give a proper 
first-time reaction, okay?"
choice_data_list: No matter how many times I see it,...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe, yeah, you're right.
choice_data_list: No matter how many times I see it,...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Likewise.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Thank you for reaching this place with me!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, seriously... We fi-na-lly made it 
here~!
choice_data_list: So this is where your dream began.
So this is where your dream started.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yeah!
choice_data_list: So this is where your dream began.
So this is where your dream began.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
A super sparkly, totally celebrity 
dream...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I've come back to make it come true.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Together with everyone from back then,
and 
with my new family!
choice_data_list: Maybe I should build a private gym...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: To Dubai? Aha, that's the absolute best♡
choice_data_list: Maybe we should set up a private g...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Trainy, is your heart ready to become 
super wealthy?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: You're the best♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You know... there's something I suuuuper 
want!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
—I'm gonna stand at the top of the world! 
Together with the strongest, most 
beee-loved besties ever! ♡
